import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { AnnouncementService } from 'src/app/services/announcement.service'; import { Announcement } from 'src/app/models/announcement.model'; @Component({ selector: 'app-announcement', templateUrl: './announcement.component.html', styleUrls: ['./announcement.component.css'], }) export class AnnouncementComponent implements OnInit { announcements: Announcement[] = []; newAnnouncement: Announcement = { title: '', message: '', date: '', }; constructor(private announcementService: AnnouncementService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.loadAnnouncements(); } loadAnnouncements(): void { this.announcementService.getAll().subscribe((data) => { this.announcements = data; }); } submit(): void { this.newAnnouncement.date = new Date().toISOString(); this.announcementService.create(this.newAnnouncement).subscribe(() => { this.newAnnouncement = { title: '', message: '', date: '' }; this.loadAnnouncements(); }); } delete(id: number): void { this.announcementService.delete(id).subscribe(() => { this.loadAnnouncements(); }); } }
